messages:
maria: quick question — re: pin metadata for rollouts. we want a way to express cohort+compat guarantees so the router can pick safe fallbacks. can we add fields to the pin object (not the release manifest) or should we only point to an external manifest?
chris: +1 we need something lightweight in the pin so routing decisions are local. heavy manifests are slower to resolve during cold-paths.
linh: +1 for lightweight. propose these minimal fields on the pin: `cohort`, `stability_hint`, `compat_tags`, `expires_at`, `release_url` (optional). example: 
```json
{
  "pin": "llama-7b@2026-03-15",
  "cohort": "canary-42",
  "stability_hint": "experimental",      // enum: stable|best_effort|experimental
  "compat_tags": ["tok:v1","kv-v2"],
  "expires_at": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
  "release_url": "https://releases/internal/llama-7b/20260315"
}
```
sam: question: how does client resolution use `compat_tags`? if tags are freeform we risk combinatorial mismatches and expensive catalog checks. also who owns tag ontology?
jess: we should insist tags be from a small enum (transport, tokenizer, kv_layout, quant_profile). server/catalog will map tag -> compatibility bucket. fallback behaviour: prefer same cohort variant, then same compat_bucket, then any stable model.
maria: telemetry concern: we need pin-level signals in tracing: `pin_reason`, `pin_owner`, `pin_cohort` so we can alert when rollouts degrade quality. can those be part of the pin too or separate?
kevin: try to keep on-pin payload small (<= 4 fields). my preference: store 3 compact tokens on the pin: `cohort`, `compat_keys` (comma list), `stability` and push human metadata to `release_url` manifest (owner, notes, evals). router uses the 3 tokens only.
chris: tradeoff: small pin = fast routing, but more opaque when debugging. we can require `release_url` for any non-stable pin so ops can fetch details on demand. also add `pin_ttl` semantics for GC.
linh: implementation note — schema change should be additive and optional. runtime should ignore unknown fields. please avoid nesting heavy objects in the pin to keep cache-friendly lookups.
jess: ops procedure: when creating a cohort pin, include `cohort` + `compat_keys`. create release manifest with detailed evals. add a rollout tag `canary:true` in the manifest for dashboards.
deploy-bot: deploy created pin llm/llama-7b@20260315 to pool-3 (cohort: canary-42) — ci: passed, smoke: failed (flaky) :eyes:
maria: ok action items: 1) small RFC to add `cohort`, `compat_keys` (list/CSV), `stability` (enum), `expires_at` and optional `release_url`. 2) require `release_url` for non-stable/production pins. 3) runtime ignore unknown fields. 4) telemetry fields (pin_owner/pin_reason) live in release manifest but optionally mirrored as short owner id on the pin. anyone object?
chris: +1
kevin: +1
sam: +1
jess: +1 — can we target a doc + PR this week?
maria: will draft RFC and a tiny migration script for resolver to treat missing fields as "stable" default. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
